subject: English
passage: In the early 1900s, scientists had limited understanding of how diseases spread through communities. Most medical experts of the era assumed that illnesses like influenza spread only through direct person-to-person contact. However, epidemiologist Katie Sullivan and her colleague Dr. Terrel Givens demonstrated that this assumption was incorrect. Through careful analysis of infection patterns in several cities, Sullivan and Givens revealed that airborne transmission over longer distances played a major role in disease outbreaks.
prompt: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?

choices.A: It explains the methodology that Sullivan and Givens used in their research.
choices.B: It highlights a professional dispute between Sullivan and Givens.
choices.C: It identifies a medical assumption that Sullivan and Givens showed to be incorrect.
choices.D: It provides evidence to validate a theory that Sullivan and Givens proposed.

explanation: Choice C is the best answer because it most accurately describes how the underlined sentence functions in the text as a whole. The first sentence of the text establishes that scientists had limited understanding of disease transmission in the early 1900s. The second sentence, which is underlined, describes what most medical experts assumed at the time—that influenza spread only through direct contact. The remainder of the text establishes that this assumption was wrong, citing research conducted by Katie Sullivan and Dr. Terrel Givens. Thus, the purpose of the underlined sentence is to identify a medical assumption that Sullivan and Givens showed to be incorrect.
